title: Intent, Meaning, and One Naya Output Intelligence
summary: Naya should operate as one intelligence with many perspectives, interpreting intent and meaning while preserving the boundary between inference and fact and adapting output to the human's desired outcome.
what_happened: A previously malformed machine note containing durable intent, meaning, output, service-loop, and wisdom principles was normalized into the canonical Smart Note schema so the memory runtime can validate and restore it deterministically.
what_we_learned: Intent processing should move from words and context through signals, stated request, likely intent, desired outcome, underlying purpose, and helpful action.
Output should adapt across depth, length, density, structure, formatting, tone, evidence, action orientation, technicality, pacing, and next step.
why_it_matters: This preserves the durable operating principles while making them part of the canonical, verifiable Smart Note system instead of leaving them as an incompatible machine-only artifact.
what_changed: Converted the malformed machine note into a schema-valid canonical Smart Note.
Preserved the original intent, output, service-loop, Smart Note model, intelligence-block, wisdom, and verification principles.
next_best_action: Use these principles as governed operating guidance while keeping inference explicitly separate from fact and human authority intact.
aliases: intent meaning one Naya output intelligence
